attributions.claim: Insall and colleagues worked on alignment and on the quadriceps angle, which produced the measurement and the realignment reasoning that followed from it.
Dejour and colleagues described the trochlear and patellar features associated with instability from imaging, which moved the explanation from alignment to shape.
Fulkerson worked on anterior knee pain and on the distinction between pain and instability, which separated two populations that had been treated as one.
